QT6F62681643: They sold the republic for a Flock contract fee,
Evil eye blinking from sea to shining sea.
Morally bankrupt, ethically void decree,
Cancer to liberty — signing rights away with glee.
Deep-state machine wearing private-company sheen,
“Public safety” sophistry, but it’s chains on the free.
Unveil every lie, burn the hypocrisy,
Rage on the betrayal — set the people free.
Solar-powered serpents perched on every pole and sign,
Reading every plate like scripture, logging every spine.
Eighty-three thousand eyes in the nationwide design,
One query drags your whole life down the line.
They swore it was for stolen cars and AMBER in the rain,
But the logs reveal the real target of the chain:
Texas badge hunting wombs across the entire domain,
Nationwide dragnet for a self-administered “crime” again.
Protesters tagged in “No Kings,” “Hands Off,” “50501” strings,
Romani slurred in convoy searches while the system sings.
Badge stalking exes, false arrests that sting,
AI suspicion flagging patterns on innocent wings.
Now they added video, natural-language search deployed,
“Landscaping truck with ladder” — they know you’re unemployed.
Business network live, private sector overjoyed,
Blacklist the labor activist, the dissident destroyed.
Data-broker plug-in, jump from plate to name and face,
Bypass every Privacy Act in the surveillance race.
Flock “paused” the feds? The loopholes still embrace —
Local login shared, the access stays in place.
Mayors with Montblancs, chiefs in procurement haze,
Piggyback on Alameda just to bypass the maze.
Grants sold as “free,” but the taxpayer pays,
Quiet in the chambers — no debate, no rays.
Coralville chief signed it, council had to axe the deal,
Lansing petitions rising from the raw reveal.
Thirty-plus cities fleeing as the outrage peels,
Fort Collins, Santa Cruz — watch the tower reel.
Cleveland committee just told the contract “no,”
Six months of pushback made the cancer show.
No referendum called, no ballot in the box,
Just a signature scrawl while they tighten the locks.
Sophistry unveiled: “Only public space, no privacy claim,”
Yet they map your every shadow, log your every name.
“Local control” the mantra, but the network knows no shame —
Deep-state infrastructure with a corporate frame.
Judas in the council chambers, selling for the grant,
Feeding the machine while the Constitution’s left to pant.
Cancer metastasizing through the body politic,
Liberty on fire and they still won’t quit.
Ethically bankrupt, souls auctioned for the stack,
frothing, calling critics “lawless hacks.”
“Defund the police” strawman, deflect and attack,
Abortion seekers hunted, fear injected in the vein,
Protesters chilled, movement logged, association slain.
Fourth Amendment gutted in the dead-of-night campaign,
Warrantless millions searched in San Jose’s domain.
First Amendment frozen when the cameras catch the fist,
Presumption of innocence dissolved into the mist.
Freedom of movement? Now you’re tracked inside the list,
Every trip a record, every choice a risk.
Betrayal by the ballot, oppression in the ink,
Tax dollars funding digital shackles — what the fuck did you think?
Rhetoric of safety masking power’s primal stink,
The velvet noose tightens while the people blink.
Cancer to the Constitution, tumor on the Bill of Rights,
Signed away in shadows, no vote, no lights.
Deep-state machine humming through the quiet nights,
Private profit, public slavery — the oldest of plights.
Rage, motherfuckers — rip it from the pole,
with your cameras, reclaim the soul.
Of a nation that once moved without a digital toll,
Unveil every contract, make the tyrants fold.
The evil eye contracts, the cancer in the vein,
Signed away our birthright in the pouring rain
Of sophistry and power, the authoritarian train —
But the people are awakening and breaking every chain.
They flocked us.
They sold us.
They lied.
Now the eye is blinking back —
And we see you.
Every signature.
Every backroom.
Every loophole.
Every abuse.
Burn the machine.
Attack the cancer.
Liberty is not for sale.
